charts.title: Kepler-1651 b: orbits around Kepler-1651
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-1651's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-1651 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mann et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153..267M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2017): P 9.87863917 d

charts.title: Kepler-1651 b: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-1651 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (80, 81, 82) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 48353358, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 20 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 27 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 20 min late; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 9 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
